name: Painted leather trunk with Tobias and the Archangel Raphael
note: Domed-lid wooden trunk covered in painted leather and studded with nails. It shows Tobias, the Archangel Raphael and the dog on the front, and a standing Virgin on the end panel. It looks like Spanish colonial work, probably Peruvian, from the 17th or 18th century. I couldn't find a source for this exact piece.
